Game Overview

Zaho Bot is a adventure title where guide your robot through a labyrinth of high-tech dangers in Zaho Bot, a thrilling action-platformer. Collect elusive chemical flasks while deftly avoiding lethal lasers and cunning adversaries. Master the art of double jumping through progressively challenging levels, where every decision tests your agility and strategic thinking.
